app_fee.value: The postgraduate prospectus, which also covers research degrees, says there is no fee for applying.
app_fee.quote: There is no fee for applying.

fee_waiver.value: The University says overseas candidates must pay the fee difference or win one of very few overseas fee waivers, with very high competition.
fee_waiver.quote: We expect overseas candidates to either cover the difference in tuition fees themselves or qualify for an overseas fee waiver from the University. | There are very few fee waivers available and competition is very high.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on the university or department pages checked.

toefl_min.value: All PhD applicants need a TOEFL iBT score of 88 overall, with Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20 and Writing 26.
toefl_min.quote: All Postgraduate Research degrees (i.e. PhD and Masters by Research) require: | TOEFL iBT: 88 overall, with Reading 18 Listening 17 Speaking 20 Writing 26.

ielts_min.value: All PhD applicants need IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with Writing 7.0 and no other band below 5.5.
ielts_min.quote: All Postgraduate Research degrees (i.e. PhD and Masters by Research) require: | IELTS: 6.5 overall. Writing 7.0. No other subscore lower than 5.5.

english_waiver.value: Indian applicants can skip the English test with Class 12 English at 80% or more for research degrees, or with a degree from a listed Indian university taught in English (valid 3 years).
english_waiver.quote: Class 12 English Language: 70% for UG (valid for 2 years) and PGT study, and 80% for Research Degrees (both valid for 5 years) | At Royal Holloway, we are able to accept a Bachelor's or Master’s degree completed at the following Indian universities as proof of English competency.

notes: Lab-based science projects can carry bench fees on top of tuition (up to GBP 5,000 a year in Biological Sciences and GBP 6,000 in Earth Sciences, set per project). Check the program page for each department's rule.
